column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to promote and advance the science and practice of
project management in Sri Lanka ;
to  foster  professionalism  in  the  management  of
projects ;
to help in obtaining and exchanging academic and
industrial research and technical knowledge in the
field of project management by introducing speedy
communication systems and  discussions thereon,
by  establishing  and  maintaining  technical  and
management  libraries,  publications  on  matters  of
professional interest and any such other means ;
to  promote  the  study  of  project  management,
to  encourage  original  research  and  provide  a
recognized  forum  for  the  free  exchange  of  ideas,
applications and solutions with a view of facilitating
the  scientific  and  economic  development  of
Sri Lanka ;
to  conduct  examinations  for  the  granting  of
membership of the Corporation to test the competency
of persons engaged in project management and to
grant certificates of competence ;
to  determine  the  eligibility  of  candidates  for
admission to various grades of membership;
to  maintain  ethics,  standards  and  accreditation  in
the field of project management ;
to regulate the professional activities and to assist
in maintaining high standards in the field of project
management ;
